Item.Name: S_INV_PRODUCT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter inventory product type or press [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :s_inv_product_type is not null
 then
 begin
 select product_type_desc
 into :s_inv_prod_desc
 from vserv_product_types vpt
 where product_type = :s_inv_product_type
 and sysdate between vpt.eff_date
 and nvl(vpt.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 show_error_dist('0322');
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :s_inv_prod_desc := '';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :std_price is not null and
 not :std_price between 0 and 9999999.99
 then
 show_error_dist ('0400');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.form_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 :global.record := :system.cursor_record;
 :global.action := 'CLEAR';
 GO_ITEM('confirm');
 else
 clear_form(NO_VALIDATE);
 execute_trigger('PRE-FORM');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.form_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 else
 show_error_dist('0601');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.form_status = 'CHANGED'
 then
 :global.record := :system.cursor_record;
 :global.action := 'EXIT';
 GO_ITEM('confirm');
 else

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.last_record != 'TRUE'
 then
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.trigger_record != 1
 then
 up;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: CONFIRM
Item.Hint: Enter 'Y' to clear or exit, 'N' to resume entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 if :confirm = 'Y'
 then
 clear_form(NO_VALIDATE);
 if :global.action = 'CLEAR'
 then
 execute_trigger('PRE-FORM');
 else
 exit_form;
 end if;
 elsif :confirm = 'N'
 then
 go_block('product_codes');
 go_record(:global.record);
 else
 show_error_dist('0318');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
